independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the list row, the trigger and link rows, the caret and the popup composite.

intent: Move between the sections of a site from a bar of links, some of which open a panel of more links

properties.description: The open item's value, '' when closed (Base UI value): an item's value attribute, else its index. Setting it (attribute or property) opens or closes without a change event.
The item open at first connect when no value attribute is present (Base UI defaultValue).
horizontal (default) or vertical: the list direction, which arrow keys move focus, and the popup beside (vertical) or below the open trigger.
Hover: open an item after the pointer rests this long on its trigger, in ms (Base UI delay); default 50. Moving between triggers while open switches at once.
Hover: close this long after the pointer leaves the triggers and the popup, in ms (Base UI closeDelay); default 50.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: change
events.trigger: hover, a trigger press, ArrowDown on a trigger, Escape, an outside press, focus leaving or a close-on-click link opens, switches or closes an item; value is '' when closed; preventDefault keeps it as it is

semantics.role: navigation (named by label); the list is role=list of listitems; triggers are role=button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; links are links (aria-current=page when active)

keyboard.keys: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight (ArrowUp, ArrowDown when vertical; mirrored in RTL), Home, End
keyboard.action: move focus between the list's triggers and links

keyboard.keys: ArrowDown on a trigger (ArrowRight when vertical)
keyboard.action: open its content and focus its first link
from an open trigger into its content, from its last link on to the next item
close the content; focus returns to its trigger

content.children: [data-part=item] children (or a [data-part=list] of them; ul / li work): an item with label holds its content's links; an item holding one link is a plain link; or author [data-part=trigger] and [data-part=content] inside an item. Links are <a> elements (data-part=link is set on them); active marks the current page, close-on-click closes the menu when pressed.

constraints: Contents move into the shared viewport when the element builds; they keep their ids, and each trigger's aria-controls names its content.
Only links belong in the contents (the menu is navigation, not a command menu).
Setting value from script opens or closes an item without a change event.

avoidWhen.reason: A menu gives command semantics (role=menu, menuitems) and roving focus.
Tabs keep the views in the page and name the active one.

avoidWhen.when: A single control with a panel of settings.
avoidWhen.reason: A popover anchors one panel to one trigger.

nodes.summary: The row (or column) of items (role=list): a composite without a fill. Base UI NavigationMenu.List.
One entry (role=listitem; data-value names it): a trigger whose content shows in the viewport, or a link. Base UI NavigationMenu.Item.

Opens its item's content (role=button, aria-expanded, aria-controls, data-popup-open while open): a composite option in the construction pattern with a caret in trailing (Base UI Icon), turned while open. Base UI NavigationMenu.Trigger.
An item's links, in the shared viewport (hidden unless open; data-open / data-closed, data-activation-direction). Base UI NavigationMenu.Content.
A link (in the list or in a content): a composite option; data-active and aria-current=page on the current page. Base UI NavigationMenu.Link.
The floating layer (popover=manual, in the top layer while open), 1u below the open trigger. Base UI NavigationMenu.Positioner.
The surface: a composite container sized to the open content (--popup-width / --popup-height, reveal intent). Base UI NavigationMenu.Popup.
Where the open content shows; clips the content while the popup's size animates. Base UI NavigationMenu.Viewport.
